about: A real Cargo Commander save written by the pre-M9.1 code (the parent of 4aa0fd3), captured by running that code over the real runtime (node:sqlite, GAME_TEST_CONTENT, fakeClock(), instance ids cargo-commander-learner-a-<now>-<n>): delivery 1 shipped right, then on delivery 2 a wrong WEIGH (committed, wrongTries 1) and a partial load, then BACK TO ELEVATOR. settings holds the learner's eq.mg.cargo-commander.* settings exactly as that code left them. The save key is <signature>#<n>, n the visit's own count of right loads (1 here). Used by legacySave.test.ts; re-capture it if the cargo content or the item seeds change.
